morphology.pattern_note: 英语及苏格兰背景的专有名称，整体记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。词头保留资料包小写形式，实际人名应写作 Lindsay。/d/ 不在所列常见英语读音中单独实现；具体读音以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 林赛；英语及苏格兰背景的姓氏，也用作个人名字。
senses.en_definition: Lindsay: an English and Scottish surname, also used as a given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga dan juga nama peribadi dalam masyarakat berbahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 在此指专有名词，不是马来语普通名词。仅凭该名字不能推断性别、国籍或某一具体人物。下列为马来语称呼组合，不能据此声称存在适用于所有同名者的固定高频搭配。资料包未提供 DBP 释义，本条为名称说明。[Lindsay 名称研究](https://one-name.org/name_profile/lindsay/)

etymology.historical_story: Lindsay is a place-derived surname associated with Lindsey in Lincolnshire, England. The Lindsay One-Name Study traces its Scottish association through Walter de Lindsay and his connection with the future David I of Scotland. Historical documents contain numerous spellings, including forms related to Lindsey and Lindesay. The name later also became a given name. None of this supplies a Malay lexical meaning or identifies which Lindsay appears in the corpus. [Lindsay One-Name Study](https://one-name.org/name_profile/lindsay/)
